public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        String s = sc.nextLine();
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(s);
        int i = 0;
        boolean f = false;
        while (i < sb.length()) {
            if (i + 1 < sb.length() && sb.charAt(i) == 'a' && sb.charAt(i + 1) == 't' && i != 0 && i != sb.length() - 2 && !f) {
                sb.replace(i, i + 2, "@");
                f = true;
            } else if (i + 2 < sb.length() && sb.charAt(i) == 'd' && sb.charAt(i + 1) == 'o' && sb.charAt(i + 2) == 't' && i != 0 && i != sb.length() - 3) {
                sb.replace(i, i + 3, ".");
            }
            i++;
        }
        System.out.println(sb.toString());
        sc.close();
    }
}
